quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #21
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: On a road with no sidewalks, where should a pedestrian walk?

options.text: On the side with the lightest traffic.
On the same side traffic is moving.
On the side facing oncoming traffic.
On the side with the heaviest traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: On the side facing oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: Walk on the side of the road where you can see traffic coming toward you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop.
No U-turn.
Yield.
Do not enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not enter.
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in that direction.

questions.question: How do you check your blind spots when changing lanes?

options.text: Use the inside rearview mirror.
Use the outside rearview mirror.
Use both the inside and outside rearview mirrors.
Turn your head and look over your shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look over your shoulder.
questions.explanation: Turn your head to check your blind spots before you change lanes.

questions.question: What is the correct way to use a freeway exit ramp?

options.text: Slow down before entering the exit ramp.
Slow down after you move onto the exit ramp.
Keep your speed the same once on the exit ramp.
Pass slower vehicles on the exit ramp.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down after you move onto the exit ramp.
questions.explanation: Wait until you are on the exit ramp to slow down. Do not slow down before entering it.

questions.question: What is the minimum age to get a motorcycle instruction permit?

options.text: 14 years old.
15 years old.
15 and one-half years old.
16 years old.

questions.correctAnswerText: 15 and one-half years old.
questions.explanation: You must be at least 15 and one-half years old to apply for a motorcycle instruction permit.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow light mean?

options.text: Stop and look for traffic, then go if the intersection is clear.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Speed up to cross the intersection quickly.
Slow down and continue with caution.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and continue with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and drive carefully through the intersection.

questions.question: What is true about a work zone?

options.text: It can be moving or stationary.
It is marked with black and white signs.
You do not need to slow down or pay extra attention.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: It can be moving or stationary.
questions.explanation: Work zones can be in one place or moving. They are marked with orange signs with black letters or symbols. Always slow down and pay close attention in a work zone.

questions.question: Why is it important to watch for motorcycles?

options.text: They are harder to see than cars.
They rarely use their headlights.
Motorcyclists are less skilled than other drivers.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: They are harder to see than cars.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles are smaller and easier to miss than cars. They can hide in your blind spot. It is hard to judge their distance and speed, so always stay alert around motorcycles.

questions.question: What color are road markings that separate traffic moving in opposite directions?

options.text: Yellow
White
Yellow and white
Yellow, white, and black

questions.correctAnswerText: Yellow
questions.explanation: Yellow lines divide lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.question: What should you do at a railroad crossing with no traffic signals?

options.text: Always come to a complete stop.
Slow down and be ready to stop.
All railroad crossings have signals, so you will never see this.
Speed up to cross quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Slow down at an unmarked railroad crossing. Look and listen for trains on all tracks before crossing. If you see or hear a train, stop at a safe distance and wait for it to pass.

questions.question: When changing lanes, you should:

options.text: Use only your mirrors.
Start signaling as you move into the next lane.
Signal at least 500 feet before changing lanes on residential streets.
Always check your blind spot.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always check your blind spot.
questions.explanation: Other cars and motorcycles can hide in your blind spot. Look over your shoulder before changing lanes. Signal 100 feet before changing lanes on residential streets. Signal five seconds ahead when changing lanes on a freeway.

questions.question: When merging onto a freeway, it is usually best to:

options.text: Go slowly while waiting for an opening.
Speed up faster than the traffic around you.
Turn on your hazard lights until you are safely on the freeway.
Speed up to match the freeway traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed up to match the freeway traffic.
questions.explanation: Use the on-ramp to speed up to match freeway traffic. This helps you blend in safely. Traffic entering the freeway must yield to traffic already on it.

questions.question: Most warning signs are what color?

options.text: Red.
Yellow.
Green.
Blue.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yellow.
questions.explanation: Most warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about unexpected road conditions.

questions.question: When driving on slippery roads, you should:

options.text: Always drive at the speed limit.
Use cruise control to keep a steady speed.
Follow other cars more closely.
Avoid sudden changes in speed or direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid sudden changes in speed or direction.
questions.explanation: Do not make sudden changes in speed or direction on slippery surfaces. Slow down on slippery roads and do not use cruise control.

questions.question: A solid red arrow on a traffic signal means:

options.text: It is never used as a traffic signal.
It means the same thing as a red circular light.
You can turn in the direction the arrow points.
Traffic in that direction must stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same thing as a red circular light.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same as a red circular light. You must stop and cannot turn in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: If you need to stop quickly and your car does not have Anti-Lock Brakes (ABS), you should:

options.text: Press and hold the brake pedal.
Pump your brakes firmly and quickly.
Tap the brakes lightly.
Release the brake pedal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pump your brakes firmly and quickly.
questions.explanation: Pumping your brakes is the best way to stop in an emergency. The car will stop quickly and you can still steer.

questions.question: You see a flashing yellow light at an intersection. You should:

options.text: Stop and wait for the light to turn green.
Make a U-turn because the intersection is closed.
Drive carefully through the intersection.
Get ready to stop because the light is about to turn red.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive carefully through the intersection.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means proceed slowly and carefully through the intersection. Look both directions for traffic.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Sharp right turn.
A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
Winding road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Roundabout ahead.
Lane ends, merge left.
Make a U-turn.
Curve ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Roundabout ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a roundabout is coming. Enter at low speed and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: You are turning left from a two-way street onto a one-way street. After completing the turn, your car should be in:

options.text: The right lane of the street.
The center of the street.
The left lane of the street.
The lane with the least traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane of the street.
questions.explanation: When turning left from a two-way street onto a one-way street, complete the turn into the lane closest to the lane you just left.

questions.question: What do pentagonal signs indicate?

options.text: No passing zones.
School zones.
Speed limits.
Railroad crossings.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zones.
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs mark school zones. When you see one, watch carefully for children and pedestrians.

questions.question: Which does NOT affect how far it takes to stop your vehicle?

options.text: Steering ability
Braking distance
Reaction distance
Perception time

questions.correctAnswerText: Steering ability
questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on perception time, reaction distance, and braking distance. Your speed and road conditions change these distances. Steering ability does not affect stopping distance.

questions.question: You are in the left lane and want to move right. What should you do?

options.text: Check your mirrors, signal, and look over your left shoulder for other vehicles before changing lanes.
Check your mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder for other vehicles before changing lanes.
Check your mirrors, signal, and look over both shoulders for other vehicles before changing lanes.
Check your mirrors, signal, and change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder for other vehicles before changing lanes.
questions.explanation: Always check your mirrors and signal before changing lanes. Look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move to check your blind spot.

questions.question: When you approach an intersection with no traffic signs, what should you do?

options.text: Maintain your speed and proceed.
Stop, check all directions, and proceed.
Yield to all other drivers.
Be ready to yield.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to yield.
questions.explanation: At uncontrolled intersections, yield to vehicles coming from your right. Always be ready to yield to avoid a crash. Do this by easing off the gas, keeping your foot near the brake, and looking left, right, and left again.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop ahead.
Buggy warning.
Limited parking.
Do not block intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road hazards. This sign warns you that a stop sign is ahead. Slow down and get ready to stop.
